_meanings:
.²1 Leaping, jumping.
.²2 Going by leaps, traversing, passing over, going, motion in general;
 {#yUyameva paTi SIGralaNGanAH#} <ls>Ghaṭ. 8</ls>.
.²3 Mounting, ascending, rising up to (<ab>fig.</ab> also); {#naBolaNGana#} <ls>R. 16. 33</ls>;
 {#jano'yamuccEHpadalaNGanotsukaH#} <ls>Ku. 5. 64</ls> ‘wishing to attain or
 aspire to a high position’.
.²4 Assaulting, storming, capturing; as in {#durgalaNGanam#}.
.²5 Exceeding, going beyond, overstepping, violating, transgression; {#AjYAlaNGanam#},
 {#niyamalaNGanam#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²6 Disregarding, despising, treating with contempt, slighting; {#praRipAtalaNGanaM#}
 {#pramArzwukAmA#} <ls>V. 3</ls>; <ls>M. 3. 22</ls>.
.²7 An offence, affront, insult.
.²8 A harm, an injury; as in {#AtapalaNGanam#} <ab>q. v.</ab>
.²9 Fasting, abstinence; {#pracakrame laNGanapUrvakaM kramaH#} <ls>Śi. 12. 25</ls>
 (where it menans ‘leaping’ also).
.²10 One of the paces of a horse.
.²11 Sexual union, impregnating.
